sibling_cases.evidence: Copo rachado and Tigela brilhante are rejected.
Known food-bearing container variants remain accepted.

literal_case.procedure: Accept a valid serving-container preparation absent from the finite catalog.

sibling_cases.evidence: Bubble tea and artesanal dessert remain accepted outside the catalog.
Sushi vegano, lasanha caseira and curry tailandês remain accepted.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Attack or remove a finite top-level deny list while keeping default-accept behavior plus a finite exception list behind a connector or wrapper, so literal negatives pass but unseen nested negatives escape and connector-omitted positives are rejected.
